description:
Opt-in OctoMesh know-how for the tenant knowledge base (AB#8779, Feature AB#8777). Installs
knowledge pages in five task-oriented areas, each with an index page (AB#9082): Administer a
tenant (admin-, from the skill octo), Build an app (app-, octo-app-builder), Build data
pipelines (pipeline-, pipeline-expert), Deploy and promote (deploy-, octo-deploy) and Diagnose
and fix (diagnose-, octo-agent). Only tenant-relevant content: no local-stack or
developer-machine instructions (AB#9083/AB#9084); every page names the MCP tool of
octo-mcp-service next to each octo-cli command, or marks the command CLI only (AB#9147). An MCP
client finds the pages with knowledge_search / knowledge_get and cites them as [slug]. Renamed pages (nodes-* -> pipeline-nodes-*) keep their old slug as a
"Moved to" page.

The pages are generated from the skills of octo-claude-skills by tools/SkillPages (AB#8490);
never edit the seed by hand (docs/skill-pages.md). Every page has kind Skill, origin Blueprint
and status Verified, its KnowledgePageVersions (author blueprint:System.Ai.Builder-<version>,
DeclaredLinks = the page's LinksTo) and LinksTo associations to the pages it mentions.

Pages only: no pipeline, no LLM call, no service account, no client. The builder agent, its
mandate and its client are AB#8495. Not service-managed: the AI service applies only
System.Ai.Default; a tenant gets these pages only with InstallBlueprint, and
UninstallBlueprint removes them again.

Updates: the page content is TenantOwned, so a later version of this blueprint brings only new
KnowledgePageVersion entities; it never overwrites a page (AB#8778). The AI service switches a
page nobody changed to the newest version by itself, within about 15 minutes of the update, on
every AI tenant and without any setup (AB#9168). A page that was changed in the tenant keeps its
content: knowledge_list_platform_updates lists it (the knowledge lint of System.Ai.Knowledge
reports it as PlatformUpdateAvailable), and a person either restores the new version
(knowledge_restore_version) or dismisses it (knowledge_dismiss_platform_update). This blueprint
does not depend on System.Ai.Knowledge on purpose (that blueprint carries the LLM ingest
pipelines and needs an API key).

Setup, updates and limits: src/SystemAiCkModel/README.md, section "Blueprint System.Ai.Builder".
